propagate_belief: propagate a belief tensor across spatial-rotation canvases given delta XY and yaw offsets
markov_filtering: run Markov filtering over a sequence of observations, canvases, positions, and yaw angles
integrate_observation: integrate a source observation into a target belief tensor using pose deltas and canvases
RigidAligner_update: update a RigidAligner with a new observation, canvas, position, and yaw to accumulate belief
GPSAligner_update: update a GPSAligner with GPS coordinates, accuracy, canvas, position, and yaw for alignment
